name: CSC Stat Viewer
author: ethsmith
description: A React/Vite statistics viewer application with automatic GitHub updates. Pulls from a configurable GitHub repository on each restart.
startup: if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" = "true" ] && [ -d .git ]; then echo 'Pulling latest updates...' && git pull; fi && npm install --production=false && npm run build && npx serve -s build -l ${SERVER_PORT}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update
apt install -y git curl

cd /mnt/server

if [ ! -z "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" ] && [ "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" != "" ]; then
    echo "Using authenticated GitHub clone..."
    git clone https://${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}.git .
else
    echo "Using public GitHub clone..."
    git clone https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}.git .
fi

if [ ! -z "${GITHUB_BRANCH}" ] && [ "${GITHUB_BRANCH}" != "main" ]; then
    git checkout ${GITHUB_BRANCH}
fi

npm install

echo "Installation complete!"

variables.name: GitHub Repository
variables.description: The GitHub repository to clone (format: owner/repo, e.g., ethsmith/csc-stat-viewer)

variables.name: GitHub Branch
variables.description: The branch to clone and pull from

variables.name: GitHub Token
variables.description: Personal access token for private repositories (leave empty for public repos)

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Automatically pull updates from GitHub on server start (true/false)
